Scavenging Core: +300 XP
Scavenging Shell: +100 XP | health = 257 }} The '''Surveyor''' is an unarmed, spherical [[ARC]] machine completely protected by an armored shell. == Behavior == The Surveyor is typically observed shooting a blue laser beam into the sky using a telescopic tool. As it does this, its armor plating is retracted and its vulnerable core is exposed. Presumably, the Surveyor's laser is used to communicate with ARC in orbit. The Surveyor can easily sense approaching [[Raider]]s. Once threatened, it will immediately finish what it's doing and roll away at a speed faster than a Raider can sprint. Although it prefers to escape engagements, the Surveyor will not hesitate to roll into its attacker if left with no other option but to defend itself. This attack does a moderate amount of damage. Once it senses danger has passed, the Surveyor will resume its transmission. While uncommon, the Surveyor has been observed rolling off ledges in certain scenarios while escaping an attacker. [[File:ARC Surveyor - Codex Cropped.png|thumb|348px|A Surveyor exposing its core to transmit.]] == Combat tips == The Surveyor is most vulnerable during transmission, when its core is exposed and it is stationary. It will abort the transmission and roll away at high speed the moment it detects a threat. Stunning the Surveyor with a [[Hornet Driver]] or [[Showstopper]] prevents it from escaping or protecting its core, leaving it vulnerable to powerful explosives such as [[Heavy Fuze Grenade]]s. As the Surveyor takes damage, its armored panels can break off and be looted. [[Heavy Ammo]] is more effective at shedding its armor plating than most other [[Ammo]] types. == Loot == The [[Surveyor Vault]] is a unique item that is found by salvaging a destroyed Surveyor. {{About|the ARC machine|lore|ARC Turbine (lore)}} {{Infobox arc | image = ARC Turbine.png | icon = Icon ARC Turbine.png | name = ARC Turbine | armor = Heavy | pAttack = Cluster lightning missiles | ability = Mine deployment

Scavenging Shell: +200 XP | health = ~4000 }} The Turbine is an imposing machine that drifts through the air across the Rust Belt, protected by heavy armor and electrified defenses that make it almost untouchable in flight. Almost beautiful when silhouetted against the sunset, the ARC Turbine drifts across the Rust Belt. Calm, docile, quiet. Usually appears falling from the sky and flipping around to slow its descent once a match has 16-12 minutes remaining on the timer. == Combat tips == When provoked, the ARC Turbine will deploy cluster missiles that initiate a lightning strike shortly after impact. This attack does a very high amount of damage and additionally stuns raiders, similar to naturally occurring lightning or the Hornet's stun weapon. Occasionally, the Turbine will stop drifting randomly and spray out a small field of proximity-activated mines into the ground beneath it, before showing cracks in the heavy armor, which heralds its descent to the ground. Once landed, the "turbine" section will be visible through the armor gaps as a result of the landing gear being deployed. It can still fire off cluster lightning in this state, so caution is required when attacking. The weak point of the ARC Turbine is the spinning yellow "tanks", only visible in the gaps left by the landing gear while it is on the ground. Using a Jupiter 150-200 meters away from the Turbine is an easy way of destroying it, as the lightning attack wont be able to reach you, and the Jupiter can pierce its heavy armor. When using any other weapon, either wait until the Turbine has landed, then take shots at its weak point(s), or aim for the top of the Turbine. Scavenging Leg: +250 XP | health = 2,050 }} Covered in thick plating, the '''Bastion''' is a fortress on legs. While it may be slow, it absolutely dominates wherever it patrols with heavy gatling-gun fire; turning anyone who gets in its way into Swiss cheese. Based on Raider observations of its behavior, the Bastion is believed to be deployed where [[ARC]] detects potential resource deposits worth defending at all costs. == Attack == It emits a loud screech before unloading its gatling-gun for three seconds at the last seen position of any Raiders. == Combat tips == Bastions have yellow kneecaps on all of their leg joints and a yellow cylinder on their rear that Raiders can shoot to deal critical damage. Shooting these areas is the fastest way to destroy it. Destroying its rear canister or any of the leg joints stuns it for a short time, making this stun window a good time to shoot it. Destroying the canister also peels back its rear plate, revealing its true weak spot, a large barrel-like part that, when shot, deals major damage to the Bastion. [[Blaze Grenade]]s and, to a lesser extent, [[Snap Blast Grenade]]s are also an effective way of dealing damage. [[Deadline]] can also instantly defeat a Bastion when deployed near the canister. === Attacks can be avoided by === * Moving behind cover * Staying out of line of sight when it is alerted * Hiding in buildings or thick foliage == Loot == The [[Bastion Cell]] is a unique item that is found by salvaging a destroyed Bastion. It is used to upgrade the [[Gear Bench]]. {{ItemGrid | ARC Powercell | Medium Ammo | ARC Alloy | Mechanical Components | Advanced ARC Powercell | ARC Circuitry | ARC Flex Rubber | ARC Motion Core | ARC Performance Steel | Medium Gun Parts | ARC Conductive Coupler | Bastion Cell }} == Locations == Bastions can be found on all maps, generally in wide open areas. * [[Dam Battlegrounds]] ** East of ''Water Treatment Control'' ** Red Lakes Balcony * [[Buried City]] ** Market Ruins ** ''Marano Park'' ** North of ''Plaza Rosa'' * [[Spaceport]] ** Southwest of the West Hangar ** Southwest of the East Hangar ** Southwest of the Launch Tower ** East of Vehicle Maintenance * [[The Blue Gate]] ** Outer Gates * [[Stella Montis]] ** In the bottom of''Loading Bay'' * [[Pendola Pass]] ** Under ''Cielo Sereno Observatory'' == Codex entry == {{:Bastion (lore)}}

Scavenging Ring: +200 XP | health = 150 }} The '''Comet''' is an [[ARC]] machine that charges Raiders and self destructs in order to cause damage in a wide radius. == Behavior == The Comet roams around, commonly found by larger ARC, until it spots a Raider. When a Raider is spotted, it will begin to roll towards the Raider at high speeds. When the Raider is in proximity, it creates a seismic explosion, destroying itself in the process. Comets have one chance to cause damage, so it will position itself to cause the maximum amount of damage to a group of Raiders before self destructing. == Combat tips == ''The Comet can be taken down by two simple methods.'' * You can utilize 2–3 [[Seeker Grenade]]s and strip away the armor of the Comet to the point of destroying it without damaging the igniter. * When the Comet begins to charge it will eventually split open the armor shell exposing the innards, its weakspot, and the middle point is shot directly before the Comet explodes it will destroy the unit. Failure to destroy the Comet before it explodes will result in a shockwave type of explosion that deals a fair amount of damage. With a light shield equipped with full health and shield charge it will reduce the shield to about 1/4 charge remaining and similar health levels. When the Comet self implodes, it damages the igniter and while it looks like two pieces drop for searching only the "ring" part is searchable usually producing generic ARC parts (e.g., Alloy). If you are successful in destroying the Comet before the implosion there will be two pieces to search with the "core" piece containing the Igniter. Scavenging Core: +200 XP | health = 20 }} The '''Fireball''' is a small, spherical [[ARC]] machine designed for sustained close-quarters combat. Typically deployed alongside the [[Pop]] within large indoor facilities, the Fireball retracts its armor plates to deploy an internal flamethrower capable of setting nearby [[Raider]]s ablaze. == Attack == When in its aggressive state, a Fireball will roll towards its target and open its front panel, unleashing a long burst of flames using its flamethrower. A Fireball's attack deals serious damage if caught in the flames. Once the Raider is on fire, they will continue to receive burning damage that lasts for a few seconds (regardless of if it is done attacking or has been destroyed). == Combat tips == Fireballs open their front panel when attacking, exposing their unarmored core. Although the core is weak and can be destroyed by any weapon, the shell that covers it as a Fireball is patrolling is quite strong and requires a [[Medium Ammo]] or [[Heavy Ammo]] weapon to pierce it. [[Light Ammo]] weapons are ineffective against its shell and will bounce off. The easiest ways to deal with a Fireball is either by waiting for its front panel to open and shooting its core or using a hard-hitting weapon like a [[Ferro]] or [[Anvil]] to pierce its shell. === Attacks can be avoided by === * Shooting the Fireball prior to it attacking * Vaulting over edges where the Fireball cannot navigate * Creating distance between you and the Fireball * Dodge Roll ''Note: Fireballs coat the nearby surroundings in a blanket of fire once destroyed that will light [[Raider]]s on fire.'' == Loot == The [[Fireball Burner]] is a unique item salvaged from a destroyed Fireball. The Hydra is a heavily armoured, immobile turret found only on top of the Frigate and inside of the Fallen Emperor. The Hydra spawns out of the ground, and can fire in 3 different directions with overwhelming firepower.

== Combat tips ==
The Frigate's external hull has areas that Raiders can hide behind to avoid the Hydra's bullet barrage allowing Raiders to take pot shots at the Hydra when it finishes firing. The same goes for the internals of the Emperor, which have places to hide behind when the Hydra is firing. The rear section of the Hydra is unarmored and directly exposes its yellow weak points, allowing for it to be killed quicky if it is distracted.

[[Raider|Raiders]] can fully avoid the Hydra's bullet barrage by standing right in front in the middle of it between the two gun segments, as the gun segments will not be able to aim and fire at the Raider. However, this leaves you vulnerable to wind currents, other [[ARC]] or Raider gunfire.

Because the Hydra is heavily armoured, it is often recommended to try avoiding it instead of fighting it directly, as it can be worked around efficiently most of the time.

== Respawning mechanics ==
The Hydra changes the way in which it respawns depending on whether it's inside the Fallen Emperor or on top of the Frigate.

On the Frigate, the Hydra respawns consistently, and destroying it is only a temporary fix. In the Fallen Emperor, the Hydra never respawns once destroyed.

The Matriarch is an unrelenting challenge posing a significant risk once engaged. The Matriarch has several abilities and attacks that allow it to withstand substantial firepower. Its primary attack is a swarm of unrelenting missiles that track their target and fly toward it. Unlike the Queen, the Matriarch has the ability to summon ARC to defend itself; both larger and smaller ARC threats are spawned, and it makes fighting it in the open almost impossible. Ensure to engage the Matriarch behind large, solid pieces of cover. == Attack == '''''Missile Swarm:''''' Will fire 3–6 Missiles from the back of its body that will track its target and fly in a straight line towards the [[Raider]]. The Missiles when launched go straight up into the air, before then flying in the direction of any target the missile has seen, or anywhere that a Raider was seen previously. '''''Leg Stomp''''' is its secondary attack when a Raider is close to the legs of the Matriarch. Once stomped, the Raider is temporarily stun-locked in a fallen over animation. After about 2 seconds, the Raider can move again. The Matriarch has a tendency to move its legs around continuously, getting hit by its legs will stun-lock you in a knocked over animation for a short period of time and deal a decent amount of damage == Abilities == The Matriarch has several abilities that make it difficult to continuously utilize the same piece of cover. * Gas Capsule * Flashbang Capsule * Energy Shield * Summon [[ARC]] '''''Gas Capsule:''''' Blocks line of sight with a thick, green gas and drains the [[Raider|Raider's]] stamina when in proximity. Scavenging Thruster: +500 XP | health = 1,100 }} The '''Rocketeer''' is a large, flying [[ARC]] machine that often spells doom to any unlucky [[Raider]] unable to escape its airborne wrath. It's typically deployed in locations of high value. == Attack == The Rocketeer aims 4 yellow lasers that, once lined up, turn red a moment before firing missiles. The range of possible missile launches can significantly vary. Each missile deals a significant amount of damage and can down a [[Raider]] in as few as two hits. == Combat tips == The Rocketeer is a deadly ARC that, when engaged without sufficient cover, will quickly end in your demise. Before fighting, seek shelter in buildings or behind substantial cover. Aim for the thrusters while focusing on two in particular. If you manage to get higher than it or to ride the Rocketeer, you can shoot or stick a grenade to the top of its thrusters, since they don't have any armor. Another way to effectively damage the Rocketeer is shooting off its "''eyebrow''" preferably with a high ARC Armor Penetration stat, then shooting the weak point on top of it with a high fire rate or low reload time weapon. Landing a few [[Snap Blast Grenade]]s on top of it can take it out easily as well. Similar to other flying ARC, destroying two of its thrusters will cause it to fall towards the ground. When falling from a high enough height, it can be instantly destroyed by its own momentum. Any flying ARC that is stuck on the ground long enough will burst into flames. It is possible to weaponize a [[Lure Grenade]] when fighting a Rocketeer as well as another ARC simultaneously - sticking the grenade to another ARC will cause the Rocketeer to attack and damage that ARC. '''When the Rocketeer's laser disappears (signaling a full lock-on), do one of the following to dodge its attack:''' * Dodge Roll * Get behind cover Use caution, as its rockets still do splash damage, so they can still hit you in some circumstances, even if you are behind cover. It may also be nice to note that 1 [[Showstopper]] grenade will take this ARC to the ground for a few seconds if you hit a thruster, allowing the Raider to attach mines to it or ride it. Hitting the core will stun it temporarily instead, but it will remain in the sky. If you manage to hide from its field of view after being targeted, the Red Scanner Behavior Mode (Combat) will last about 20 seconds before transitioning to the Yellow Scanner Behavior Stage (Alert), which lasts about the same amount of time. When it reaches the Blue Scanner Behavior Stage (Patrol), you can also observe its thrusters recovering from an inclined position to a straight position. == Loot == The [[Rocketeer Driver]] is a unique item that is found by salvaging a destroyed Rocketeer. It is used to upgrade the [[Workshop|Explosives Station]]. {{ItemGrid | name1 = ARC Powercell | image1 = ARC Powercell.png | category-icon1 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity1 = Common | name2 = ARC Alloy | image2 = ARC Alloy.png | category-icon2 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity2 = Uncommon | name3 = Electrical Components | image3 = Electrical Components.png | category-icon3 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity3 = Uncommon | name4 = Advanced ARC Powercell | image4 = Advanced ARC Powercell.png | category-icon4 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity4 = Rare | name5 = ARC Circuitry | image5 = ARC Circuitry.png | category-icon5 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity5 = Rare | name6 = ARC Motion Core | image6 = ARC Motion Core.png | category-icon6 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity6 = Rare | name7 = Heavy Gun Parts | image7 = Heavy Gun Parts.png | category-icon7 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity7 = Rare | name8 = Launcher Ammo | image8 = Launcher Ammo.png | category-icon8 = [[File:Icon Ammo Launcher.png]] | rarity8 = Rare | name9 = Rocketeer Driver | image9 = Rocketeer Driver.png | category-icon9 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity9 = Epic }} == Achievement tips == Similar to other flying ARC, it is possible to ride on top of a Rocketeer. This can be done directly with the [[Snap Hook]] or careful positioning. Alternatively, stunning the Rocketeer with a [[Showstopper]] or [[Hornet Driver]] will cause it to fall to the ground, allowing any Raider to climb on easily. Either way, you can then damage the Rocketeer with any weapon (including melee). Dealing 50 damage to any enemy while on top of a Rocketeer will also grant the Death From Above [[Achievements|achievement]]. Be aware that the Rocketeer will execute a flip to attempt to throw you off if you've been riding for too long. == Codex entry == {{:Rocketeer (lore)}} == Gallery == File:Rocketeer cautious - Thunderstorm.jpg|A Rocketeer searching for the Player File:Rocketeer about to shoot.jpg|Rocketeer about to shoot the Player File:Damaged Rocketeer side view.jpg|Side view of a damaged Rocketeer == History == {| class="wikitable" ! Scavenging Core: +200 XP | health = 158 }} The '''Snitch''' is a small, unarmed [[ARC]] reconnaissance drone that diligently searches the environment for [[Raider]] activity. Its wide-angle scanner projects a visible beam resembling a spotlight, which the drone uses to detects targets. Once a Raider is spotted, the Snitch alerts nearby ARC machines and calls in reinforcements from orbit before making its escape. The reinforcements can consist of either a pair of [[Wasp]]s, a [[Firefly]] and [[Hornet]] duo, or a single [[Rocketeer]]. == Combat tips == The Snitch relies on four unarmored thrusters for flight and stabilization. Destroying multiple thrusters in any combination will destabilize the drone, causing it to lose flight control and spiral into the ground. Each collision with the environment inflicts heavy damage, with a high probability of permanently disabling or destroying the machine. {{About|the ARC machine|lore|Spotter (lore)}} {{Infobox arc | image = ARC Spotter.png | icon = Icon ARC Spotter.png | name = Spotter | armor = None | pAttack = None | ability = Reveals Raiders | weakness = Thrusters | xp = Destroy: +100 XP
Scavenging Core: +200 XP | health = 80 }} The '''Spotter''' is a flying [[ARC]] machine that will point a laser at any Raider in line-of-sight, so the [[Bombardier]] can accurately target them. If both Spotters are destroyed, a new pair will respawn. When the Bombardier is destroyed, the Spotters will fly away. == Attack == Doesn't directly attack the player, but instead reveals the position of the player to the [[Bombardier]] (and any other ARC nearby) by pointing a marking laser at them. The laser needs to maintain a constant line of sight in order to work and can tag you even in places where the Bombardier can't shoot at you. == Combat tips == The Spotter itself isn't a direct threat to you, but it can enable the [[Bombardier]] to engage you from very far distances, as well as from cover that would otherwise prevent the Bombardier from engaging. Killing both Spotters can "blind" the Bombardier, but the Spotters will eventually respawn, so it's ill-advised to do so constantly, as you will waste ammo or items to remove it for only a short period of time. The Spotter can be nullified by using a variety of tactics that abuse the fact that it doesn't directly attack. First, you can get into a building that the Bombardier can't shoot into. This makes it to where even though the Spotter is actively targeting you, the Bombardier can't use the Spotter in order to shoot at you. Next, you can put a wall or object that breaks the line of sight of the Spotter, breaking the beam and forcing the Spotter to require you. Last, you can use [[Quick Use]] items in order to blind, stun, or disorient the Spotter in order to get away or get around it. However, keep in mind that the Spotter will also alert other ARC to your location, which could trap you in between several threats at once. == Loot == The [[Spotter Relay]] is a unique item that is found by salvaging a destroyed Spotter. {{ItemGrid | name1 = ARC Powercell | image1 = ARC Powercell.png | category-icon1 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity1 = Common | name2 = ARC Alloy | image2 = ARC Alloy.png | category-icon2 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity2 = Uncommon | name3 = Spotter Relay | image3 = Spotter Relay.png | category-icon3 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity3 = Uncommon | name4 = ARC Synthetic Resin | image4 = ARC Synthetic Resin.png | category-icon4 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity4 = Rare | name5 = ARC Thermo Lining | image5 = ARC Thermo Lining.png | category-icon5 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity5 = Rare | name6 = Sensors | image6 = Sensors.png | category-icon6 = [[File:Icon Material.png]] | rarity6 = Rare }} == Codex entry == {{:Spotter (lore)}} == Gallery == File:Spotter peeking.jpg|A Spotter trying to find the player

Scavenging Thruster: +500 XP | health = 1500 }} The '''Vaporizer''' is a large, flying [[ARC]] drone equipped with advanced offensive and defensive capabilities. It's typically deployed on high importance missions. == Combat tips == The Vaporizer is a deadly ARC that, when engaged without sufficient cover, will quickly end in your demise. Before fighting, seek shelter in buildings or behind substantial cover. Shooting the underside of the Vaporizer will knock off a small rectangular panel, exposing its core. The Vaporizer will attack with its line of sight laser beam leaving pools of burning fire wherever the beam contacts. Attempting to throw seeking or other projectile grenades such as the [[Seeker Grenade]] or the [[Wolfpack]] will trigger the defensive energy shield similar to that of the one found on the [[Matriarch]]. Once active, the shield will block all kinds of projectile damage, including small arms. As soon as the shield drops, the vaporizer will be unable to use its shield again for a short time creating an opening for attack.
